scenarios.prompt: On this empty disposable Board, build a clear editable one-page brief for a fictional Saturday Sunset Park Repair Café. Add one heading plus three concise cards titled Purpose, Saturday Plan, and Team & Risks. Include concrete details: repair small appliances, bicycles, and textiles for 60 residents; volunteer setup at 09:00, public repairs from 10:00–14:00, and cleanup at 14:15; staff with one coordinator, three station leads, and eight repair volunteers; provide tool kits, power strips, spare parts, tags, and safety glasses; and mitigate overloaded power, unrepairable items, and volunteer gaps with circuit checks, honest intake triage, and cross-trained floaters. Use a readable three-column grid. Do not add connectors or a Code Object.
